# Published snapshot — do not edit

Generated by `npm run build:prod` from the repository root; every build recreates this folder
from scratch, so edits made here are lost. Change the source files and rebuild instead.

Point Apache at this folder as the DocumentRoot and the Cloudflare tunnel at Apache. It holds
only what the browser loads: `index.html`, `style.css`, `src/` and `assets/audio/bgm.mp3`.
The dev-only files (`tests/`, `docs/`, `AI-task-list.txt`, `scripts/`, `node_modules/`, `.git`)
stay out of it on purpose.

three.js and h3-js come from jsdelivr and the fonts from Google Fonts, so the page needs
outbound network access but no other local files.
